message:
The other day, I found myself rummaging through some old boxes in the attic and stumbled upon my grandchildren's favorite board games from when they were little. I dusted off a few and gathered the family for a game night. As we laughed over Monopoly and shared stories, I realized how refreshing it was to put away our screens and enjoy each other's company without distractions. 

In the spirit of preparedness, it reminded me that sometimes the simplest joys can create the strongest bonds. It’s nice to know that while we prepare for unexpected events, we can also make cherished memories during everyday moments. Have you rediscovered any old favorites lately?
